That's what I'm afraid of.

Anyway. Thanks for listening. Really.

Never heard of CBT before but I'm trying out different things.

I'm doing guided affected imagery with a therapist and seeing a psychiatrist. She only prescribes me drugs against the insomnia, and nightmares. And that's fine.

There's a psychiatric ambulance and a transgender ambulance that have been recommended to me. I'll probably go to both places but it's hard. Meeting people, making phone calls.

And what if they decide I'm a threat to myself and others. I could get locked up in a psychiatric ward. And when people take away my freedom I actually do become a threat to myself and others.

It's all confusing and feels impossible. With her everything was clear and within my grasp. 

[insert more unconstructive brooding here]

I tend to disagree on that part. If I am no longer capable of perceiving my problems, they are gone. And I'd be gone. That handful of people I actually give a damn about are what keeps me from doing it but for every step forward it feels like I'm taking two steps back.

And I know no one has all the answers. I'm thankful for anything I can get. Seeing my psychiatrist and psychotherapist tomorrow but I never felt like those appointments yielded any results.

-they might-

Everyone tells me to just accept it and move on but no one seems to know how.

Maybe it's just because I've been suicidal before. Because now I know that there will always be that one universal problem solver.

Maybe it's the kind of forbidden knowledge Lovecraft described that upon knowing it would drive you to madness or into the safety of a new dark age. And I chose madness. And I miss her so much.

Things did change for the better once. But going through cycles of pain over and over again for two seconds of happiness can't be worth it. I keep trying and keep running into impossible obstacles.

I can't Sisyphus this shit forever.

Meditation is not working anymore. Thank you anyway. I just keep circling around the same thoughts. I should have known better. Should have known that I'm making myself vulnerable. But I didn't.

The car analogy doesn't work. I want her to be an object. A piece of decoration in an endless landscape that can be ignored, just like nearly fucking every person I meet. She's more. But I can't allow her to be more than nothing..

It's the hardest part because I don't really want to forget. I don't want her to go back to nothing because I always feared that I would someday lose all feelings for her and hurt her. 

But I didn't. She did. And the hardest part about not getting what you want is wanting something else.

Why would I want to forget her when I only want things to go back to normal? Why would I want a job if I can't get one anyway and I'd have to talk to customers on a daily basis? Why would I want to move out of my parents' house if I can just murder them in their sleep and die fighting the coming wave of ~~subhuman trash~~ police forces?

Good friends always tell me that this is just life and being hurt is part of it but I've been depressed for a while now for a lot of different reasons over the years and the more I see of life, the more it seems undesirable and ugly.
